title: Lessons from Bunk Johnson and where Bunk lived
summary: He took about ten lessons from Bunk; where Bunk lived and why he was called Bunk.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Go ahead, you were talking about Bunk when you went to Bunk to take lessons?

Yeah, I went to Bunk to take lessons. I took about ten lessons. And after that, every time I'd go by, I was trying to catch him. You'd never see that. Where did Bunk live in those days? Oh, on Villarreal Street.
Villarreal, about where on Villarreal Street?

There was between, I'd say between Tudor, between Fenton and the outcoaster. Yeah. On that side of the bank. Bunk would never come home. That's how they call him Bunk. You see Fenton. The other batter on the old bill batter in the bar, they'd go on knockout, put the junk in the pool. He'd never come home right away.
I never did know why they called him Bunk.
Yeah, that's why he was calling him Bunk. You have a bottle, you never bother the pool or nobody. You have a bottle wrapped up. You have something in it. Corp, little bottle, big bottle.
